args.body:
Combined summary of https://blog.bellwether.example/2026/freight and its companion piece (https://insights.bellwether.example/freight/companion):

- Spot freight rates fell 9% this quarter while contract rates held steady.
- Fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel prices.
- Shippers who split volume across three carriers paid the least.
args.title: Freight market summary (Bellwether blog, 2026)
